# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** Nine years old  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c22 P19](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0019), [v2 c27 P4](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0004), [v3 c13 P7](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0007)</sub>

- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v3 c22 P39](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0039), [v3 c28 P7](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0007)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Davy-boy  <sub>[v2 c16 P3](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0003), [v2 c16 P20](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0020), [v2 c24 P11](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0011), [v3 c1 P34](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0034), [v3 c22 P23](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0023), [v3 c28 P9](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0009)</sub>; Mr. Davy Keith  <sub>[v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy has a round head covered in a crop of fuzzy yellow ringlets, roguish hazel eyes, and a positive snub nose. He has a dimple in one cheek that gives him a comical, lopsided look when he laughs. Although often dirty from playing in mud or clay, he is considered a handsome little lad when properly dressed and cleaned.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P31](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0031), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c20 P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c25 P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

## Personality

Davy is a mischievous, energetic, and extremely curious boy who is always full of questions and eager to learn about everything. He possesses a boundless appetite for cake and plum jam, and he delights in exciting stories filled with action. Though prone to tricks and impetuous misbehavior, he has a very affectionate, warm heart and feels deep remorse whenever he realizes he has upset Anne.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 c8 P13](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0013), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 c8 P53](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0053), [v2 c10 P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052), [v2 c14 P18](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0018), [v2 c18 P12](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0012), [v2 c20 P14](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0014), [v2 c25 P41](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0041), [v2 c26 P30](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0030), [v3 c13 P83](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0083)_

## History

Following the death of his sick mother, Davy and his twin sister Dora were brought from East Grafton to Green Gables by Marilla Cuthbert. From his arrival, he engaged in constant antics, such as dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church, placing a toad in Marilla's bed, locking Dora in a dark shed, and squashing lemon pies. Under Anne Shirley's affectionate guidance, his behavior gradually improved after he learned that lying and misbehaving were wrong. When his uncle Richard Keith passed away, money was left in trust for Davy and Dora, allowing them to remain permanently at Green Gables. He enrolled at the Avonlea school, becoming fast friends with Milty Boulter and competing with his peers while growing taller.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P2](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0002), [v2 c8 P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 c8 P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 c10 P36](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0036), [v2 c10 P53](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0053), [v2 c17 P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c21 P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 c22 P19](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0019), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P23](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0023), [v2 c26 P31](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0031), [v3 c40 P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006)_
